title: Vegetable Biryani
tagline: A colourful, aromatic biryani of mixed vegetables layered with saffron basmati.
intro: Vegetable biryani proves that no meat is needed for a showstopping rice dish. Seasonal vegetables are cooked in a fragrant yoghurt masala and layered with saffron-scented basmati, then steamed. Wholesome, vibrant and endlessly adaptable, it's a favourite for vegetarian tables and buffets.

items: 500 g mixed vegetables (carrot, potato, beans, cauliflower, peas, capsicum)
Whole spices: cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, bay leaf
½ tsp saffron in 3 tbsp milk

method: Rinse and soak the rice; drain.
Fry the onions golden; add ginger–garlic paste and chillies.
Add the vegetables and all the spices; sauté for a few minutes.
Add the tomatoes and yoghurt and cook until the vegetables are just tender and the masala is thick. Do not overcook — they finish during dum.
Parboil the rice to 70% in salted, spiced water; drain.
Layer rice over the vegetables with saffron milk, fried onions, herbs and ghee.
Seal and dum on the lowest heat for 20 minutes.
tips: Cut vegetables to a similar size so they cook evenly.
Add paneer cubes or cashews for a richer version.
imageAlt: Colourful vegetable biryani with mixed vegetables and saffron rice
